name: Do I need layout and hookup coordination, or is that only for full remodels?

mainEntity.name: Do I need layout and hookup coordination, or is that only for full remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full layout-and-hookup coordination project typically becomes important when you are **moving plumbing, electrical, gas, or venting**. If the appliance locations are changing, someone needs to confirm the sink drain, dishwasher connection, range power or gas line, and hood vent all line up before cabinets go in.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need coordination whenever appliance locations change or hookups must be moved. Even a small kitchen update can require checking plumbing, electrical, gas, and venting before installation starts.
